svg.title: Tremor Scroll: the Pulse map strip
svg.desc: The Pulse map: a margin strip on the back pages of Old Resin's recipe book, the bark's plates drawn as a grid from the Crown down to the roots with the three listening posts beside it. Each faceless mark placed has shaded one plate in chalk grey; the shading gathers under Highridge, and one plate is ringed in gold: where the second tap will land.
